meta.title: Optimize tool agent prompt usage
meta.body_summary: Prompt optimization to reduce orchestrator prompt verbosity by providing only concise instructions for tool agents and listing full schemas only when running them directly, adding a flag for schema inclusion.

perf_labels.notes: Self-closed PR with no reviews; narrative prompt optimization with failing CI; no perf evidence or maintainer interaction.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 32 changed lines, this is a tiny edit. As a prompt optimization PR, it is small in scope but was closed without merge, likely due to lack of evidence and failing tests.
